input.command:
python3 -c "
# In obs 21: cam at (-0.5, 1.8), heading 270 (facing -x).
# Cabinet base meets floor at y = 481!
d_cab_front_21 = 256 * 1.55 / (481 - 255.5)
print(f'Cabinet front dist in obs 21: {d_cab_front_21:.2f} m')
x_cab_front = -0.5 - d_cab_front_21
print(f'x_cab_front: {x_cab_front:.2f} m')

# Let us also measure table in obs 21:
import cv2, numpy as np
img21 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0021.png')
# Table leg bottoms:
mask_table = (img21[:,:,2] > 80) & (img21[:,:,2] < 150) & (img21[:,:,1] > 35) & (img21[:,:,1] < 80) & (img21[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_table)
print('Table bottom y in obs 21:', ys.max(), 'center x:', xs.mean(), 'min x:', xs.min(), 'max x:', xs.max())
d_table_21 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Table dist in obs 21: {d_table_21:.2f} m')
x_table = -0.5 - d_table_21
y_table = 1.8 + (xs.mean() - 255.5)/256 * d_table_21
print(f'Table x: {x_table:.2f}, y: {y_table:.2f}')
"
